name: Question 8
problem:
Given that $g(x,y,z)=\frac{\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2}+{y}^{2}-1)}{z}$ and

$$
\frac{∂g}{∂x}=\frac{2x}{z({x}^{2}+{y}^{2}-1)},\,\frac{∂g}{∂y}=\frac{2y}{z({x}^{2}+{y}^{2}-1)},\,\frac{∂g}{∂z}=-\frac{\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2}+{y}^{2}-1)}{{z}^{2}},
$$

find the set of values $(x,y,z)$ where all partial derivatives of $g$ exist.

Question 8
?

Given that g(x,y,z)=ln⁡(x2+y2−1)z and ∂g∂x=2xz(x2+y2−1),∂g∂y=2yz(x2+y2−1),∂g∂z=−ln⁡(x2+y2−1)z2, find the set of values (x,y,z) where all partial derivatives of g exist.

a
{(x,y,z):x2+y2>1,z≠0}
b
{(x,y,z):x2+y2≠1}
c
{(x,y,z):x2+y2>0,z>0}
d
{(x,y,z):x2+y2≠1,z≠0}
e
{(x,y,z):x2+y2>1}
